asChild.description: Use the provided child element as the default rendered element, combining their props and behavior.

render.description:
Render the part as a custom element, combining their props and behavior.

Call `props()` to spread the part's props, passing your own to merge them rather than overwrite them.
The state arrives as an accessor:
`render={(props, state) => <button {...props({ onClick: mine })}>{state().open}</button>}`

defaultValue.description:
The initial value of the checked radio when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the value of the radio group.

disabled.description: If `true`, the radio group will be disabled

form.description: The associate form of the underlying input.

ids.description: The ids of the elements in the radio. Useful for composition.

invalid.description: If `true`, the radio group is marked as invalid.

name.description:
The name of the input fields in the radio
(Useful for form submission).

onValueChange.description: Function called once a radio is checked

readOnly.description: Whether the radio group is read-only

required.description: If `true`, the radio group is marked as required.

value.description: The controlled value of the radio group
